_comment: Developer-declared meaning of GA4 App events for 次うた (nextuta). Only events listed here may be interpreted by the agent; every other event name stays an opaque label. Keys must match products/nextuta.json ga4_app keyEvents. State only what triggers the event and what it records. Do not rate importance.

song_sung.definition: Fires when the user marks a song as sung (records it to sung history) in the app. Represents a sung-song action for that track, not an App Store download.

add_to_wishlist.definition: Fires when the user turns ON the '覚えたい' (want to learn) tag for a song. In this app wishlist means learn-later only, not a generic shopping wishlist.

add_to_can_sing.definition: Fires when the user turns ON the '持うた' (can sing / owned repertoire) tag for a song. Separate from add_to_wishlist (覚えたい).

open_song_link.definition: Fires when the user opens an external song link (YouTube practice, DAM, or JOYSOUND karaoke). Provider and purpose are carried as event parameters when present.
